thread:
Alice Chen: kicking off phased roll-forward for model mpt-30b-int8-v3 on /chat. plan: 2% -> 10% -> 25% over 30m stages. gating: latency p95 < 220ms, hallucination_rate delta <= 0.8pp, BLEU/ROUGE-like eval delta >= -0.5. auto-fallback if any safety metric breaches or latency +40% sustained for 5m. (will shadow with fp16 for problematic slices)
Ben Ortiz: copying. what's the precise auto-fallback rule syntax? need to add to rollout config so console can enforce.
Alice Chen: good call. added snippet below, will push to rollout config API.
```
rollout: phased
stages: [2, 10, 25]
duration_minutes: 30
gates:
  - name: latency_p95
    compare: relative
    threshold_percent: 40
    window_minutes: 5
  - name: hallucination_rate
    compare: absolute
    threshold_pp: 0.8
  - name: quality_delta
    metric: rouge_l
    threshold: -0.5
auto_fallback: true
```
Cara Singh: tiny nit: hallucination_rate is computed on the production prompt slice (prod-safety-set) with n=2500 samples, right?
Alice Chen: yes — prod-safety-set, stratified by prompt type. sampling seed fixed. also track slice-level deltas (long-form, instruction-following, factual-qa).
deploy-bot: starting canary: model=mpt-30b-int8-v3 route=/chat percent=2 id=canary-1755554321
ops-bot: metric update: baseline latency p95=150ms; initial canary p95=168ms (+12%). not flagged.
Ben Ortiz: pushed eval harness to collect hallucination signals and rouge-lite every 5m. will post summary.
ops-bot: fact-check-run: hallucination_rate baseline=1.2% ; canary=1.9% (+0.7pp) — still below 0.8pp threshold.
Cara Singh: that's close to threshold for some slices — long-form slice shows +1.6pp. need to watch.
Alice Chen: thanks — enabling shadow fp16 for long-form slice and lowering next stage to 15% until smoke passes. toggling now.
deploy-bot: updated canary config: next_stage_percent=15 ; shadow(fp16) enabled for slice=long-form
ops-bot: alert: long-form slice hallucination delta = +1.8pp sustained over 8m -> exceeds absolute gate (0.8pp). auto-fallback triggered: initiating rollback to model=mpt-30b-int8-v2
Ben Ortiz: woah — auto-fallback executed. any logs why long-form is worse? quant artifacts or prompt-length kv cache problem?
Cara Singh: initial traceback from eval harness shows tokenization edge-cases for very long system messages; also increased repetition pattern on sequences >1024. suspect int8 quant rounding interacting with attention kernels.
Alice Chen: agreement. next steps: 1) revert canary traffic (done by fallback), 2) run intensive shadow with fp16 and int8 side-by-side on the long-form slice, 3) run a constrained quant-sensitivity test (vary clip values) and a KV-cache stress test. I can open a quick runbook.
Ben Ortiz: I'll start the shadow runbook job: job id=shadow-1755554400 ; will collect pairwise A/B scoring, token-level divergence, and KL per prefix.
Cara Singh: we should also tag the failing slice as a watchlist entry and add to model onboarding checklist: "long-seq quant smoke test". prevents re-promote without passing.
Alice Chen: yep adding to checklist and gating rules. Proposed checklist item text: "Quantized models must pass: (a) long-sequence hallucination ≤ baseline +0.5pp on prod-safety-set (b) token divergence < 0.02 KL on 512+/prefixes (c) no p95 latency regressions >20% on target hardware." Anyone object?
Ben Ortiz: fine by me.
Cara Singh: fine. also recommend an intermediate canary build with per-layer quant tracing enabled so we can isolate the layer causing divergence.
Alice Chen: good idea — will spin a trace-enabled int8 build and run it in shadow.
ops-bot: rollback complete. traffic back to mpt-30b-int8-v2. canary terminated.
deploy-bot: note: manual promote blocked until Claire (model-owner) signs off and shadow jobs pass.
Ben Ortiz: will upload initial A/B report to drive link in ~20m. expecting token-divergence spike localized to attention block 6-9.
Cara Singh: thanks. also logging a temporary rule to disable auto-promote for int8 variants until we add the long-seq smoke test.
Alice Chen: summary: auto-fallback did its job — prevented a wider rollout. follow-ups: run shadow fp16 vs int8 pairwise, layer-trace, adjust quant clip, add long-seq smoke to onboarding and gating. I'll file a short postmortem doc and tag eng-runtime + eng-ml. :white_check_mark:
Ben Ortiz: 👍
Cara Singh: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: postmortem link placeholder: https://redwood.internal/pull/infra/quant-longseq-175555
Alice Chen: thanks team — closing thread, will ping when shadow results are in.
